controls: Declared bounded search only; no global-optimality claim
All saved LP inputs replayed without physics by the verifier
falsification: All seeds floor nonzero and no certification passes gate 3.
hypothesis: Tilting the root can bring new tarsus points into the contact set; either the residual floor drops below the live-contact bound or a feasible pose is certified.

parameters.descent_dofs: every non-root DOF row (actuated and passive) plus three world-frame root-rotation axes; root x,y are dead by translation symmetry and root z is re-derived per probe
parameters.descent_rule: deterministic cyclic coordinate descent: joint DOFs in row order then rotation axes x,y,z; rotations applied as world-frame axis-angle premultiplications; probes exceeding max_root_tilt_rad from the seed orientation are rejected without evaluation
parameters.objective: passive-subsystem minimum scaled balance error with LIVE contact re-derivation per probe, identical to FE-02-contact-descent-v1
parameters.scope: Static witness generation; contacts are re-derived per probe but this is a bounded declared search, not global posture optimization; no dynamic or biological claim
parameters.verification: replay of saved-input LPs in the same SciPy/HiGHS family; no independent physics or biological check

question: Freeing root orientation (three world-frame rotation axes, bounded tilt) on top of all 66 joint DOFs, does live-contact descent reach exact subsystem feasibility or a floor below the established nonzero bound?
success_criterion: A certified pose reaches the passive-subsystem or full-support gate under live contacts.
